description: Shows the modelling scene that `model_run` builds: one picture of it (or of `object`) from the front, right and top (orthographic, so sizes read true against the grid) and a three-quarter view, under a neutral studio light with a ground grid whose step it states, and one line per object: name, type, place, turn and scale, material (colour, roughness, metalness) and, for a mesh, triangles, size, whether it is closed, its volume and genus. With `object`, that object in full; with `cameras`, those views instead of the four.

cameras.description: Up to 9 views in place of the four, each { label, position, lookAt } in the scene's metres (lookAt defaults to the middle of what is framed).

object.description: The name of an object in the modelling scene: frame the picture to it and list it in full.

size.description: The picture's side in pixels (1024 by default, at most 1568).

name: model_look
